name: Shenzhen V&T Technologies Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen V&T Technologies Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, manufacturing, sale, and service of industrial automation products and systems in China and internationally. It offers industrial automation products, including inverters, elevator control system, PLC, HMI, and servo drives; energy vehicles, such as electric vehicle motor controllers and low-voltage power controllers; and smart gateway, as well as V&T digital cloud, an enterprise digital cloud service platform for IoT, edge computing, data analysis, and product promotion. The company also provides medium and low-voltage frequency inverters, DCDC power supplies, elevator integration products, and other power electronic accessories; customized solutions; and software and tools. In addition, it offers pre and after-sales services; and maintenance services. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
